conventions.coordinates: three.js: Y up, ground is the XZ plane. 1 world unit ~ 1 metre; a player is ~2.3 units tall.
conventions.anchor: bottom-center: put the sprite position at the feet / base; in three.js Sprite.center = (0.5, 0).
conventions.world_height: Suggested on-screen height in world units; width = height * (cell_w / cell_h).
conventions.billboard: cylindrical = always faces the camera around the Y axis (THREE.Sprite is fine).
conventions.filtering: Pixel art: NearestFilter for magFilter keeps crisp pixels; alphaTest 0.5 (alpha is hard 0/255).
conventions.facing_rows_monster: front, side, back; side is drawn facing `side_faces`, mirror for the other side.

sprites.description: Petualang pria rambut coklat, rompi kulit (pemain).
